CVE-2026-53615 affects libblkid DOS partition 64-bit bounds checking in util-linux before 2.41.4. The Debian security update util-linux 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 was released specifically to address the CVE-2026-5361x family for trixie and incorporates the upstream fix from v2.41.4 (commit 05c2dbadf34cc74192287f377904afaaf4061623). This version does not contain the vulnerable code path.
Package util-linux in Debian does build with readline support but chfn and chsh are provided by src:shadow and util-linux is configured with --disable-chfn-chsh.

Vulnerability affects the security.json template shipped with Solr 9.4.0-9.10.1 (SOLR-18233). The DHI Solr image does not configure authentication by default; operators who enable Solr basic auth using the shipped template accept the risk documented in the advisory. Fix was backported to branch_9x on 2026-06-24 (apache/solr#4519) but 9.10.1 predates the backport (tagged 2026-01-20) and no 9.10.2 tag has been cut. Statement will be revisited when a 9.10.x point release containing the backport ships or when 9.11.0 is released.

Fix is in Jetty 10.0.31, which has not yet been released (tip of the 10.x line is 10.0.26 on both git and Maven Central as of 2026-08-03). Per the upstream GHSA, the vulnerable code lives in jetty-client (jetty-core/jetty-client/src/main/java/org/eclipse/jetty/client/DigestAuthentication.java) and covers outbound Digest authentication from Jetty's HTTP client. Solr 9.10.1 pins Jetty 10.x and cannot consume the 12.x fix without an upstream Solr code change. Statement will be revisited when Jetty 10.0.31 ships upstream and can be pinned via the versions.props/versions.lock bump step.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
